"$(cat <<'EOF'
Fix silent fallback to default config on invalid YAML

When a .bivvy config file contained non-mapping YAML (e.g., a bare
string or list), load_config_value returned the raw value which then
nuked the merge accumulator via deep_merge's catch-all pattern,
ultimately producing BivvyConfig::default() with no warning.

Validate the parsed YAML type in load_config_value: reject non-mapping
values with a clear ConfigParseError, and convert null (empty/comment-
only files) to an empty mapping so they act as harmless no-ops during
merge rather than resetting accumulated config.
EOF
